info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Account Management Securities Position Keeping-spec
info.description: This API allows for the updating of securities positions within account management services. It facilitates the modification of existing positions to reflect accurate information, such as changes in quantity or value. Financial institutions and asset management firms typically leverage this API to ensure their securities records are current and compliant with regulatory requirements. By using this API, developers can streamline the management of client portfolios, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of financial data.

put.description: This operation allows users to update the information related to the securities position keeping for accounts in the account management system. It ensures that all relevant data is accurately reflected and maintained.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the securities position keeping in the account management system. The request must include the necessary details in JSON format as defined by the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the securities position has been updated.
